prompt: Your closest friend is spending much more time with a new group and you feel replaced and jealous. What response best protects the friendship?

options.text: Tell your friend honestly that you miss time together without accusing them, ask to plan something, and keep building your own other connections too
Talk badly about the new group whenever you can, so your friend chooses you instead
Message constantly demanding reassurance that you are still their best friend
Pretend you do not care and cut them off first before they can drift further

explanation: Honesty about missing them, without trying to control who else they see, keeps the friendship open. Badmouthing, clinging, and pre-emptive cutting off all push a drifting friend further away.
